detail.title: MK710 V2 TKL Keyboard & Mouse Combo - Mercury
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MK710 V2 is a compact tenkeyless combo featuring an 87-key mechanical-feel membrane keyboard with UV-coated, injection laser-carved ABS keycaps that resist fading over time, paired with an Aero-Jet RGB gaming mouse offering adjustable 1200-3600 DPI tracking. Its TKL layout drops the numpad to free up desk space for sweeping mouse movements while retaining all essential gaming keys, and cool multi-colour RGB backlighting adds vibrant visual flair across both devices. A Type-C adapter is included for compatibility with modern devices, and broad platform support spans PC, Laptop, PS3, PS4, PS5, Xbox and Mac. True USB plug-and-play connectivity means no additional drivers are needed, finished in a clean Mercury white colourway.
